title: The Cinched Knot Course
summary: A course that teaches the student to tie a knot of soul force that tightens on its own and to loosen it again on an ally.

title: A Treatise on the Waiting Snare
summary: A treatise on laying a snare of soul force that waits unseen until a hostile soul steps into it.

title: The Paired Fetters Lessons
summary: Lessons on casting two fetters in one motion so that one holds the opponent's intent while the other holds the opponent's reach.

title: The Chain of Hands Course
summary: A course on linking the souls of allies in a chain so that each steadies the next and the chain bears a blow together.

title: The Far Tether Discipline
summary: A discipline of tethers cast over long reach that hold a distant soul without the student leaving a safe stance.
